steps.functionBody:
set res ""

  set off [list]
  foreach {t i s n} $offsets {
    lappend off [list $s $n]
  }
  set off [lsort -integer -index 0 $off]

  set iOff 0
  foreach e $off {
    foreach {s n} $e {}
    append res [string range $text $iOff $s-1]
    append res "("
    append res [string range $text $s [expr $s+$n-1]]
    append res ")"
    set iOff [expr $s+$n]
  }
  append res [string range $text $iOff end]
  
  set res
